# Example DeepWiki: Auto-Generated Docs for a Colab Notebooks Repo

Melvin Vivas · X post · 2026-09-25 · [Open on X](https://x.com/melvindvivas/status/2103497840811282606)

**Topics:** AI Dev Tools & Productivity · **Level:** beginner

## Summary

Shows a real DeepWiki page made from the creator's Colab notebooks repo. It's an example of the AI-generated, chat-enabled documentation DeepWiki builds for any GitHub repo, for free.

## Key points

- DeepWiki builds documentation you can chat with for any GitHub repo.
- The URL pattern is deepwiki.com/<owner>/<repo>, for example deepwiki.com/donvito/notebooks.
- DeepWiki is free to use.
- It's a quick way to understand a repo you don't know, or to add docs to your own.
